bundle.shortDescription: Fast local search for files, content, documents and images.
bundle.longDescription: Kensaku indexes filenames, file contents, PDFs, Office documents and OCR'd images into one local index. It is a desktop app and a read-only search backend for AI agents (MCP + CLI). No cloud, no telemetry.
